question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omuto n’ekibiina ky’abaana be aha mugenzo gw’okwega ogurikukurira: “Kugyeragyeranisa emitwarize y’ebishushani, omugasho, n’omugasho gw’ebintu bya tekinologia ebirikushushana.” Okukora eki, omwegyesa abanza kworeka ebintu bya tekinologia ebirikushushana, naabuuza abaana eki barikumanya ahabyo atakatanazishooroora omugasho gwabyo. Bwanyima, omwegyesa abeeshenga kwetegyereza, kureeba, n’okushoboorora ebintu bya tekinologia ebirikushushana ebirikukoresibwa omu maka: essimu, obucumu bw’omutwe, ebyoma by’okwoma omutwe, saa, leedio, ebitabo, n’ebindi. Ekyakurataho, omwegyesa atebeekanisa abaana omu bibiina by’okukora hamwe kandi n’abalagira kutebeekanisa ebintu bya tekinologia, nibaijuka ebi bareebire. Ekibiina kimwe kitebeekanisa ebintu omu muringo ogutari murungi. Ku baraabuuzibwe, abari omu kibina nibagira ngu tibarikumanya oku bakukikora. Kukwata ki oku omwegyesa yaakukora okukomeereza okwega kw’ekibiina eki ky’abaana?
answer_a: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa naayoreka enshobe ei baakozire. Naabereka oku barikubaasa kutebeekanisiza ebintu n’okushoboorora ahabw’enki kikakorwa otyo, reero naabagira kugumizamu nibakurata eky’okureeberaho.
answer_b: Omwegyesereza ebi twarora? Tukagamba aha ki? Ekigyendererwa ky’ebintu ebi buri kimwe niki? Mbwenu shi, noobaasa kubitebeekanisa ota omu bibinja? Bwanyima, omwegyesa abaha obwire bw’okubitebeekanisa omu bibinja kandi abareeba.
answer_c: Omwegyesereza abegi naabagambira ngu nibakora gye, kwonka baine kureeba emico y'ebintu kubaasa kubiteeka omu bibinja omu muringo oguhikire. Hanyuma, omwegyesereza abaha obwire obundi kubaasa kugezaho omurundi ogundi.
answer_d: Omwegyesereza naagambire ngu bakaganiire aha mirimo ya buri kintu. Obwo omwegyesereza naaraga ngu ebimwe bikoresebwa omu kyombeko, ebindi omu bwemerero, n'ebindi by'omurimo. Obuhingu omwegyesereza n'abaha obwire bw'okubitebeekanisa obuto.

question: Omwegyesi w’ekitaano, omu bwiire bw’ebintu by’omulembe eby’omutaano, naabaasa abegi kwetaba omu mpaka aha kucwekyereza ebintu ebyakozirwe n’omulingo gwabyo ogurikukwata aha bugumiizi. Bwanyima y’ebyava omu mpaka, naareeba ekikundi ky’abegi nikikwatanisa ekicwekyerezo ky’ebintu ebyakozirwe n’omulingo n’obulungi bw’ekintu. Twalandiira aha mutindo gw’abegi, n’endiiro ki hali ezi ez’omwegyesi eziyamba kucwera amananu g’ekintu eki?
answer_a: Buhiki ni okucwamu rundi okutebeekanisa enkomerero y’obwomeezi bw’ekintu rundi tekinologia, kandi tikirikukwatana n’omutindo gwakyo, nk’oku kiribaaho omutaano gw’ekintu ekirikukiraho obuhangwa rundi ekirikugira emirimo emihyaka kirekurirwe omu katale.
answer_b: N'ekicwekyo ekirikukorwa omu bwire bw'okukora ebintu, okucwamu obwire eki kintu kirikumara, kwongyera amaani okukihindura aha muheru gw'obwire obwo. Kikwatagaine n'oburungi bw'ekintu obu kirikutaahwa enshobi n'oburemeezi bw'omukozi bwabaireho bwabaireho.
answer_c: N’obwire oburikubalwa omumaisho omwebazi bw’ekintu, oburikugambwa omubucureezi bw’ekintu, okuhwaho n’okutakikozesa, hatariho kukora aha muko gwakyo, nk’oku kirikubaasa kubaho ekintu ekirikukuraireho obwengye bwabaireho omu katale abantu bakacyusa eki baraabe baine.
answer_d: Ni nsharamu erikukirirwaho omu muringo ogutari gumwe, nk’eky’okureeberaho, ahabw’okubura ebicweka ebirikusaasirwa nari okwetenga kugura ekicweka ekihyaka ekirikukiira ekya ira, ahabw’okuhinduka kw’ebintu n’omutima gw’abantu gw’okuhindura ebi baratungire, bitarikukwatana n’omutindo gwabyo

question: Omuhereza akabaasa kutebeekanisiza ki abegi, nukwo bashobore kumanya ekicweka ky'abantu eki baraabe nibenda kuheereza omurimo gwabo?
answer_a: Shaba abeeshuri bashwijume emico y'abantu abu baraabe baahumurize omuri bo ekyetengo, nukwo bashobore kutebeekanisiza amakuru, reero bakore ekikaate ky'okwetenga kumanya eki barikwenda.
answer_b: Mureke ebiina bireebe vidiyo erikworeka emirimo erikukorwa abarikuhiganwa, bamanye abantu abu barikuheereza, reero bagyeragyeranise n'abantu abu omugasho gwabo gurikubaasa kuhikaaho.
answer_c: Mubuuze ebiina kushwijuma ebicweka by'abantu eby'omukago oguriho nibiha ebintu ebirikufaanana n'ebyo barikuteekateeka, ngu bashobore kubishwijuma, bamanye enshonga ezibataaniise, bamanyise omugasho gw'ebintu ebi barikuhaayo.
answer_d: Shaba abeegi baahangyeho kandi batumize ebibuuzo by’okucungura omu interneti omu bantu ab’enjawulo nibababuza yaaba nibaija kukoresa omurimo ogu barikutebeekanisiza, kandi bakunganye ebiri omu by’abarikugarukamu, nk’emyaka, omutaano gw’omusaara, omulimo, obururu, n’obushaija n’obukazi.
